purpose: Canonical extension of the same qualitative demand/friction intelligence system. Scores are ordinal discovery priorities, not measured search volumes or eligibility evidence. This pack adds a high-friction young-housing-benefit problem pattern discovered from current Försäkringskassan guidance and 2026 analysis; truth-bearing facts remain primary-source controlled.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. A lower coverage-gap score can also mean a prior learning cycle has already added a regression, not that the user problem is unimportant.

natural_language_queries: jag är student kan jag få bostadsbidrag
jag jobbar extra ibland hur vet jag vilken årsinkomst jag ska skriva
kan jag bli återbetalningsskyldig om inkomsten ändras
jag hyr ett rum räknas det som bostad för bostadsbidrag

demand_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan has a dedicated young-person housing-benefit route and its 2026 analysis reports a substantial youth-household population while also describing falling uptake.

friction_signal.basis: The user must combine age, housing form, household status, annual income estimation and change reporting; irregular work makes the annual-income estimate especially difficult.

miss_consequence.basis: Wrong assumptions can lead to missed support, delayed application or repayment when actual income differs from the estimate and changes are not reported.

source_fragmentation.basis: Core rules and application are concentrated at Försäkringskassan, but users must connect housing documents, household changes and annual income in one decision path.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as annual income, household status, second-hand tenancy and lodger status are more complex than the natural-language question 'can I get help with rent?'.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe next action can require classifying housing form, estimating income, gathering housing documents, applying and then reporting relevant changes.

recurrence_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan's current page includes dedicated guidance and FAQs about irregular income, housing form, change reporting and repayment risk, and its 2026 analysis explicitly discusses income-estimation difficulty and repayment.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The product already locked housing-form and change-reporting misses into v07 regressions, so the remaining gap is primarily to preserve and connect that learning to demand prioritization rather than invent a new truth path.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Keep the v07 housing-form and change-reporting regressions in the canonical gate, preserve fail-closed handling of irregular income and housing form, and ask only the facts that can change route, application readiness or repayment-risk guidance.
signals.truth_rule: Verify current age, income, housing, household, document, application and change-reporting rules against Försäkringskassan before any eligibility, amount or deadline claim.
